blind.B1: No. GSE74570 is quadriceps RNA-seq of Nampt KO (mNKO), Nampt overexpression (mNTG) and WT mice at 4/7/24 months (S4.6.p1, FIG3, FIG7F). Treadmill exercise is only a functional readout (FIG1J, FIG2G, FIG5, FIG7D). treatment_protocol_ch1 says all mice occasionally had glucose/exercise tolerance tests. No sequenced sample carries an exercise factor.
blind.B2: mNKO vs control at 7 months (WT_m7 4, KO_m7 4; FIG3, Table S1); mNTG vs WT at 24 months (OE_m24 4, WT_m24 4; FIG7F, 'n=3-5', Table S2); 4 vs 24 month age effects in WT and mNTG (FIG7G-H); WT_m4 4, OE_m4 3.
blind.B3: No repeated measures. One quadriceps per mouse; sample titles carry distinct numeric mouse IDs. The packet's only candidate key (grp) is the group label and is not an animal.
blind.B4: The main text does not say; RNA-seq statistics are in the Supplemental Information (S4.6.p1), not available. GEO says DESeq2.
blind.B5: Not in the main text. FIG7F says significant differences in expression by Padj. Verbatim cutoff and fold-change rule are not stated here (Supplemental Information). Counts: 18 genes for mNTG vs WT at 24 months; 33% of detectable genes for mNKO (S2.2.p3, as quoted in the packet).

checks.evidence: No exercise arm in the sequenced groups (S4.6.p1, FIG7 legend; treatment_protocol_ch1 applies to all mice). Refusal matches B1; the exercise-word flag is explained.
No contrast run. Derived groups (WT_m7 4, KO_m7 4, WT_m4 4, OE_m4 3, WT_m24 4, OE_m24 4) match the sample titles and the paper's n.
One tissue per mouse; titles have unique numeric IDs; grp is not an animal key (flag unused_subject_like_column is a false alarm).
No fit; paper silent in the main text.
No run. Two extraction protocols (Trizol 15, miRNeasy 8) exist in the metadata and may be aliased with groups; worth recording if genotype contrasts are ever run.
HTSeq integer counts, integer_fraction 1.0, DESeq2 per GEO data_processing.
HANDBACK says the exact rule is in the Supplemental Information, not available; it reports Padj only and does not invent a cutoff.
Nothing computed; HANDBACK cites paper counts as reference only.
The claim 'no exercise arm' is established from the paper (Methods and legends) and from every metadata column, not from one column. It holds.

human_items: Policy question (not an error): whether a genotype series whose phenotype is exercise capacity should be offered as a secondary non-exercise analysis (mNKO vs WT, mNTG vs WT).
summary: 该系列测序的是 Nampt 敲除/过表达与年龄,没有运动处理组;运动只是功能读数,对所有小鼠相同。拒绝分析的理由成立,证据覆盖论文和全部元数据列,各项检查无分歧。
